map.name: Vulmar
map.trouble: Ogres under the brute Thrugg have seized the Old Foundry on the mountain and dammed the lava, so the forges of Vulmar go cold while the Ogres forge weapons of their own.

guard_bark.specifics: Hulgar keeps the mountain gate of Vulmar, shut by Mayor Dravik while the Ogres hold the Old Foundry.

first.speaker: Hulgar
first.text: Halt! Nobody goes up the mountain road. Mayor Dravik's orders. The Ogres would have you for supper!

again.speaker: Hulgar
again.text: I said nobody goes up. Go pester somebody else.

later.speaker: Hulgar
later.text: Mayor Dravik has opened the road for you. Watch your head up there -- the Ogres have been throwing rocks.

bounty_offer.specifics: Mott the carter wants the Scorpions cleared out of the Slag Pits east of town so his mules will haul ore again.

offer.speaker: Mott
offer.text:
Bah! Scorpions! The Slag Pits east of town are crawling with them. Ever since the Ogres took the Old Foundry, every kind of vermin is coming down off the mountain!

My mules won't go near the pits, and I've got ore to haul. Kill those Scorpions and I'll make it worth your while. That's fair, isn't it?

reminder.speaker: Mott
reminder.text: Are those Scorpions dead yet? I can't haul a thing!

completion.speaker: Mott
completion.text: Dead? All of 'em? Ha! Wait till my mules hear about this! Here's 100 gold for you, stranger. You earned every piece.

journal.text: Kill the Scorpions in the Slag Pits for Mott.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Thessa the smith's magic gloves were stolen down her chimney by Imps, who nest in the Cinder Caves north of town.

offer.speaker: Thessa
offer.text:
Thieves! Nasty little flying thieves! The Imps came down my chimney and stole my magic gloves right off the anvil!

Without them I can't touch the hot iron, and the whole town needs swords with the Ogres on the mountain. The Imps nest in the Cinder Caves, north of the town wall.

Will you bring my gloves back, kind sir? I'll make it worth your trouble.

refusal.speaker: Thessa
refusal.text: Oh, fine! I'll just burn my fingers then!

reminder.speaker: Thessa
reminder.text: My gloves! Have you got my gloves?

completion.speaker: Thessa
completion.text: My gloves! Oh, you found them! Now I can get back to work at last! Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.

after.speaker: Thessa
after.text: Thanks again for my gloves, brave Adventurer!

journal.text: Retrieve Thessa's magic gloves from the Imps in the Cinder Caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Thessa's magic gloves from the Imps in the Cinder Caves.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Vulmar: Pell at the bellows, Orla, and old Brom.

rumour1.speaker: Pell
rumour1.text: Can't talk now. These bellows won't pump themselves!

rumour2.speaker: Orla
rumour2.text: Mayor Dravik hasn't slept a wink since the Ogres came down off the mountain. I hear him pacing up and down all night long!

rumour3.speaker: Brom
rumour3.text: Keep your purse tied tight, stranger. The Imps will grab anything that shines.

shop_greeting.specifics: Tobb of the Red Bucket tavern, Kraddock the armourer, and old Sibba who sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Tobb
inn.text: Sit down, sit down! The ale's cold, and in this town that's a miracle! What'll ya have?

arms.speaker: Kraddock
arms.text: Welcome to Kraddock's! Finest steel in Vulmar. Better buy now. With the forges going cold, there won't be much more of it.

magic.speaker: Sibba
magic.text: Heh, heh... A customer! Come in, come in! Potions, scrolls, spell books... just don't touch the green jar.

two_givers.specifics: Guildmaster Orvald wants the jammed lava sluice west of town opened; Grubb the scrapper sells a chain tunic of doubtful origin.

offer_a.speaker: Guildmaster Orvald
offer_a.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. The Ogres have jammed the great lava sluice west of town. Without the lava, our furnaces languish and the Guild cannot arm the town against these abominable brutes.

Go to the sluice and pull the great lever. The Guild will reward you handsomely.

offer_b.speaker: Grubb
offer_b.text:
Psst! You there! Need some armor? I got a chain tunic here, hardly used. It fell in the lava twice and didn't even melt!

Yours for 100 gold. Can't say fairer than that, eh?

outcome_a.speaker: Guildmaster Orvald
outcome_a.text:
The lava flows again! Listen to those hammers ring! The Guild is in your debt, lad. Take this longsword, fresh from our own forge.

Now go and see Mayor Dravik. The Ogres will not like this one bit!

outcome_b.speaker: Grubb
outcome_b.text: Sold! Pleasure doing business with you, friend. And if the Mayor's men come asking, you never saw me.

journal_a.text: Open the lava sluice west of Vulmar for Guildmaster Orvald.

journal_b.text: Buy the chain tunic from Grubb for 100 gold.

rescue.specifics: Marga's boy Wim was dragged off by the Ogres to work the bellows of the Old Foundry.

plea.speaker: Marga
plea.text:
Please, help me! The Ogres came down in the night and dragged off my boy Wim! They took him up to the Old Foundry to work their bellows!

He's only a lad. I haven't much, but it's yours if you bring him home to me!

reminder.speaker: Marga
reminder.text: Why are you standing here? My Wim is up there with those brutes!

found.speaker: Wim
found.text: You came for me! Get me out of here, before they come back!

following.speaker: Wim
following.text: Hurry! Don't let them catch us again!

completion.speaker: Marga
completion.text: Wim! My Wim! Oh, thank you, thank you, kind stranger! Here, it isn't much, but take it with my blessing.

journal.text: Rescue Wim from the Ogres in the Old Foundry.

main_opening.specifics: Brom points the player to Mayor Dravik in the Town Hall, who sends him to drive Thrugg's Ogres out of the Old Foundry.

herald.speaker: Brom
herald.text: You must be the one Ezrin sent! Mayor Dravik's waiting for you in the Town Hall, up past the big furnace.

opening.speaker: Mayor Dravik
opening.text:
Ah, at last! Ezrin said he would send help, and not a moment too soon!

The Ogres have seized the Old Foundry up on the mountain, and that brute Thrugg leads them. They have dammed the lava and turned our own great forge to the making of Ogre weapons! If they are not stopped, Vulmar is finished, and every village in the valley after it.

Go up the mountain road, lad, and drive Thrugg out of the Old Foundry. The gate guard will let you pass.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Dravik
reminder.text: Go, lad! Every hour you tarry, our forges grow colder!

journal.text: Drive Thrugg and his Ogres out of the Old Foundry.
